rows.text: Kinnan adds one extra mana every time you tap a nonland permanent for mana, and that one mana is what turns ordinary rocks into infinite combos. Basalt Monolith taps for three, Kinnan adds a fourth, and untapping it costs three: one colourless mana of profit per cycle, as many cycles as you like. The deck is that line, three backups that do the same job (Power Artifact on the Monolith, Bloom Tender with Freed from the Real or Pemmin's Aura, and Isochron Scepter with Dramatic Reversal), the tutors that find them, and free interaction to protect the turn you go off.

rows.name: Kinnan, Bonder Prodigy
rows.text: two mana. Whenever you tap a nonland permanent for mana, add one more mana of a type it made: Sol Ring makes three and Llanowar Elves makes two. Lands do not count. His {5}{G}{U} ability looks at the top five cards and puts a non-Human creature onto the battlefield.
That ability needs real green and blue. Colourless mana from the Monolith cannot pay the {G}{U} part unless Agatha's Soul Cauldron is out (see below).

rows.name: Delighted Halfling
rows.text: its coloured mana makes a legendary spell uncounterable. This is how Kinnan, and Thrasios, resolve into open blue mana.

rows.name: Shang-Chi, Master of Kung Fu
rows.text: creatures' abilities work as though they had haste, so a Bloom Tender fetched this turn can start the Aura loop at once. He also taps for two mana of one colour (three with Kinnan), spendable on creature abilities: Kinnan's dig, Thrasios, Walking Ballista.

rows.name: Kinnan, Bonder Prodigy + Basalt Monolith
rows.text: tap for three, Kinnan adds one, untap for three: unlimited colourless. Colourless pays Thrasios, Walking Ballista and every generic cost, but not Kinnan's own {G}{U}.

rows.name: Basalt Monolith + Power Artifact
rows.text: the untap costs {1} instead of {3}, and the Monolith still makes three, so it nets two colourless a cycle with no Kinnan at all. This is the line that survives removal on the commander. With Kinnan out it nets three.

rows.name: Bloom Tender + Freed from the Real
rows.text: Freed is a blue permanent and Bloom Tender a green one, so Bloom Tender taps for {G}{U}. Untapping costs {U}, leaving one green of profit per cycle, with no Kinnan needed. With Kinnan, each tap adds a third mana of green or blue, so the loop makes unlimited green AND blue, which pays Kinnan's dig directly.

rows.name: Bloom Tender + Pemmin's Aura
rows.text: the same loop. Pemmin's Aura untaps for {U} exactly like Freed, so either Aura completes it.

rows.name: Isochron Scepter + Dramatic Reversal
rows.text: imprint Reversal. Pay {2} and tap the Scepter to cast a free copy, which untaps every nonland permanent you control, the Scepter included. Each loop makes everything your rocks and dorks produce, minus two. With Kinnan, Sol Ring alone makes three, so Kinnan, Sol Ring and the Scepter are enough. Every copy is a spell cast: unlimited storm and unlimited cast triggers.

Bloom Tender cannot tap the turn it arrives unless Shang-Chi is out, so cast it a turn early or fetch Shang-Chi first. Every one of these lines is a two-card combo: allowed in Bracket 3, used from turn 6 on.

guide.title: Turning unlimited mana into a win

rows.name: Walking Ballista
rows.text: the kill. Cast it from your hand with X as large as you like, then remove counters to ping each opponent to death. Kinnan's dig, Chord of Calling, Finale of Devastation, Nature's Rhythm, Whir of Invention and Tezzeret put it onto the battlefield with X = 0, and it dies immediately. Do that only on purpose, for the Cauldron line below.

rows.name: Walking Ballista -> Agatha's Soul Cauldron
rows.text: the backup when Ballista is in your graveyard, including right after it died entering with X = 0. Tap the Cauldron to exile Ballista; it then puts a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control, and every creature of yours with a counter gains Ballista's {4} and its ping. Unlimited mana shoots the table.

rows.name: Kinnan, Bonder Prodigy + Basalt Monolith + Agatha's Soul Cauldron
rows.text: the Cauldron lets you spend mana as though it were any colour on creature abilities, so the Monolith's colourless pays Kinnan's {5}{G}{U}. Dig until every non-Human creature in the deck is on the battlefield.

rows.name: Thrasios, Triton Hero
rows.text: {4}, and colourless pays it: scry, then a land goes onto the battlefield tapped or you draw the card. With unlimited mana it draws your whole library, Walking Ballista included. Stop once the library is empty, because a Thrasios draw from an empty library loses you the game.

rows.name: Finale of Devastation
rows.text: with X of ten or more it fetches any creature (Thrasios is the usual pick) and gives your whole board +X/+X and haste. It needs {G}{G} of real green, from the Bloom Tender loop or your dorks.

rows.name: Isochron Scepter + Dramatic Reversal + Hullbreaker Horror
rows.text: every Reversal copy is a spell cast, so Hullbreaker returns one opposing nonland permanent to its owner's hand per loop. Run the Scepter until their boards are empty, then win at leisure.

guide.title: Tutor lines — what to fetch, and when

rows.text: Find the missing half, not a payoff. With Kinnan on the battlefield, Basalt Monolith is the shortest line. If Kinnan has been removed or is about to be, find Basalt Monolith and Power Artifact. If you hold Freed from the Real or Pemmin's Aura, find Bloom Tender. If you hold Dramatic Reversal, find Isochron Scepter.

rows.name: Trophy Mage -> Basalt Monolith
rows.text: on entering, it searches for an artifact with mana value three and puts it in your hand. Trophy Mage is a Human, so Kinnan's dig cannot find it.

rows.name: Drift of Phantasms -> Basalt Monolith
rows.text: transmute for {1}{U}{U} at sorcery speed for any mana value three card: Basalt Monolith, Freed from the Real, Pemmin's Aura or Fabricate.

rows.name: Tezzeret the Seeker -> Basalt Monolith
rows.text: −3 puts the Monolith onto the battlefield untapped, so it combos this turn. −2 finds Isochron Scepter or Agatha's Soul Cauldron instead, and +1 untaps the Monolith and another rock for more mana.

rows.name: Whir of Invention -> Basalt Monolith
rows.text: instant speed, and improvise lets your rocks pay. Cast it on the end step before your turn, or in response to artifact removal. X = 2 finds Isochron Scepter or Agatha's Soul Cauldron.

rows.name: Transmute Artifact -> Basalt Monolith
rows.text: sacrifice a Signet or Talisman (mana value two) and pay {1}, and the Monolith goes straight onto the battlefield.

rows.name: Moonsilver Key -> Basalt Monolith
rows.text: finds any artifact with a mana ability: the Monolith, or Sol Ring early in the game.

rows.name: Fabricate -> Walking Ballista
rows.text: one of only two tutors that put Ballista in your HAND, where you can cast it for a real X. Otherwise Fabricate is another route to the Monolith or the Scepter.

rows.name: Formidable Speaker -> Walking Ballista
rows.text: discard a card to put any creature in your hand. Take Ballista when you have the mana, or Bloom Tender when you hold an Aura. From the next turn (or at once with Shang-Chi), its {1}, {T} untaps the Monolith once: four mana for one with Kinnan.

rows.name: Muddle the Mixture -> Bloom Tender
rows.text: transmute for mana value two: Bloom Tender, Isochron Scepter, Dramatic Reversal, Power Artifact, Agatha's Soul Cauldron or Thrasios. It cannot find the Monolith, which is mana value three.

rows.name: Green Sun's Zenith -> Bloom Tender
rows.text: X = 2 puts it onto the battlefield. With Shang-Chi out it taps for the Aura loop the same turn.

rows.name: Chord of Calling -> Thrasios, Triton Hero
rows.text: instant speed and convoke. Cast it on an opponent's end step using your dorks, so Thrasios is ready to draw on your turn.

rows.name: Nature's Rhythm -> Bloom Tender
rows.text: the sorcery version, and harmonize lets you cast it once more from the graveyard.

rows.name: Urza's Saga -> Sol Ring
rows.text: chapter III puts an artifact with mana cost {0} or {1} onto the battlefield. Sol Ring is three mana with Kinnan, which is all the Scepter loop needs.

guide.title: What to keep in an opening hand

rows.text: Keep acceleration and a combo half. Sol Ring plus Kinnan is a keep; four lands and a Rhystic Study is not, because the plan is two specific cards, assembled by turn five and used from turn six.

Protect the Kinnan cast. Delighted Halfling makes him uncounterable, and Fierce Guardianship, Force of Negation and Pact of Negation all cost nothing to hold. If he dies anyway, Basalt Monolith with Power Artifact and Bloom Tender with an Aura still go infinite without him.
Count Trophy Mage, Drift of Phantasms, Tezzeret, Whir of Invention, Transmute Artifact and Moonsilver Key as six more copies of Basalt Monolith, not as value cards.
Once mana is unlimited, find Walking Ballista in your hand (Thrasios draws it) before casting anything else, and never cheat it onto the battlefield.
